lemmas.name: maj36
lemmas.statement: ∀ (xs : List Nat) (h : majorityElement_precond xs), majorityElement_postcond xs ((xs.find? (fun x => decide (xs.count x > xs.length / 2))).getD 0) h
lemmas.proof:
by intro xs h
  unfold majorityElement_postcond
  obtain ⟨r, hr, hc, _⟩ := Refine.find_majority xs h.2
  have hr' : (xs.find? (fun x => decide (xs.count x > xs.length / 2))).getD 0 = r := hr
  show xs.count ((xs.find? (fun x => decide (xs.count x > xs.length / 2))).getD 0) > xs.length / 2
  rw [hr']; exact hc
